- Bulk g-C3N4 is a thick multilayer stack with low surface area, which limits its photocatalytic H2 evolution
- Exfoliating bulk g-C3N4 into thin mesoporous nanosheets should raise photocatalytic hydrogen evolution
- Bulk graphitic carbon nitride (BCN) as the starting photocatalyst
- Ultrasonic exfoliation of BCN powder yields CNS
